themes.name: Onboarding Confusion
themes.definition: Could not understand basic game rules, auction mechanics, or squad management upon starting.
includes: New players confused by bidding rules
Unclear player attributes or team roles
Lack of explanation for currency and energy systems
excludes: Tutorial being too long or unskippable (tutorial_length)

themes.name: Tutorial Length & Flow
themes.definition: Tutorial is perceived as overly long, tedious, unskippable, or forced on experienced players.
includes: Complaints about unskippable 20-minute intro
Forced tap sequences that prevent free play
Repeated tutorials after re-installing

themes.name: Auction Mechanics
themes.definition: Auction bidding timing, player availability, bidding bot suspicion, or auction UI lag.
includes: Outbid at the very last second suspiciously
Auction timer expiring without registering tap
Bidding currency spent without player delivery

themes.name: Lag & Performance
themes.definition: Low frame rate, screen stuttering, device overheating, battery drain, or slow animations.
includes: Game lags severely during bowling animations
Phone gets hot within 10 minutes of play
Excessive battery consumption

themes.name: Crashes & Bugs
themes.definition: App crashes to home screen, black/white frozen screens, or stuck match states requiring restart.
includes: Game crashes right when match starts
Black screen after clicking claim reward
Ball stuck in air causing infinite loop
excludes: Slow frame rate or thermal throttling (lag_performance)

themes.name: Pay To Win Sentiment
themes.definition: Perception that real-money spending decides match outcomes or grants insurmountable advantages.
includes: Opponents with purchased 7-star teams cannot be beaten
Free to play progression hitting impossible wall
Paid players always hitting sixes
excludes: Matchmaking pairing with higher rating without mention of pay (matchmaking_balance)

themes.name: Matchmaking Balance
themes.definition: Unfair match pairings, opponents having vastly higher level or squad rating, or abrupt difficulty spikes.
includes: Level 5 player consistently matched against Level 40
Squad rating gap exceeding 500 points in ranked
Unwinnable win-streak penalty algorithms

themes.name: Pricing & Shop UX
themes.definition: In-app purchases perceived as overpriced, confusing currencies, accidental purchases, or shop layout issues.
includes: Gems pack cost is unreasonable for India store
Accidental click spent gems without confirmation popup
Too many confusing currencies (coins, gems, energy, tokens)
excludes: Paid money but items never credited (support_refunds)

themes.name: Ads & Notifications
themes.definition: Excessive ad frequency, unskippable interstitial ads, ads crashing the game, or spammy push notifications.
includes: Ad plays after every single delivery or over
Watched reward ad but bonus was not granted
Too many annoying push notifications during work hours

themes.name: Support & Refunds
themes.definition: Customer support not responding, money deducted without item credit, or refund requests ignored.
includes: Deducted 299 INR from UPI but no gems received and support ghosted
Sent email to support 5 days ago with no reply
Support automated reply does not solve issue

themes.name: Localisation & Regional
themes.definition: Missing regional languages (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu), poor translations, or cultural commentary.
includes: Requests for Hindi commentary or Hindi interface
Grammatical mistakes in regional translations
Desire for local domestic tournament leagues

themes.name: Social & Multiplayer
themes.definition: Issues with friends lists, direct match invites, clan/alliance features, or chat.
includes: Friendly match with real friend does not connect
Guild / alliance chat broken or toxic
Cannot find friend by user ID

themes.name: Release & Update Quality
themes.definition: Problems, bugs, or regression introduced directly after a recent version update.
includes: Game was working fine until yesterday's update
New update ruined batting timing and controls
Forced update fails to download from Play Store

themes.name: Progression & Grind
themes.definition: Upgrade pacing is overly slow, repetitive matches, drought of upgrade cards, or stamina depletion.
includes: Takes months to level up a single player card
Energy system recharges far too slowly to play
Repetitive matches with no meaningful progression reward

themes.name: Account & Data Loss
themes.definition: Login failures (Google Play Games, Facebook), lost team progress, or guest account wipes.
includes: Logged in and my whole team was reset to level 1
Cannot link Google Play Games account
Account disappeared after phone transfer

themes.name: Other Actionable Feedback
themes.definition: Specific, actionable feedback that does not cleanly fit into any of the predefined 15 categories.
includes: Feature requests for specific cricket stadiums
Camera angle toggle requests
Unique gameplay control suggestions
excludes: Non-actionable generic praise or insults (dropped in cleaning)
Any issue fitting the 15 specific themes above
